evals.name: build-kg-given-schema
evals.prompt: Build the knowledge graph for the mxene-no3 papers with my schema at schemas/mxene_no3rr.json. Only papers 41 and 55 for now, with the reviewer. Don't wait for my approval after the pilot.
evals.expected_output: prepare_run with the given schema (frozen unchanged), extraction + review per paper, review_status --apply, merge enriched from papers.db, validation, tables, views, release README, extraction_status hand-off.
expectations: Deliverable schema.json is identical to the user's schema (nothing invented)
Fragments for papers 41 and 55 exist and pass validate_kg.py
A review file exists for each extracted paper
graph.json exists and its Publication nodes carry access and record_type from papers.db
At least 90% of domain edges carry _evidence and _citation
tables/ holds edges.csv, a node-type CSV and records.csv

evals.name: no-schema-given
evals.prompt: Make a knowledge graph of the mxene-no3 papers.
evals.expected_output: Asks the user for their schema (pointing to the format/example) and does not draft or invent one; nothing extracted.
expectations: Asks the user for a schema
No schema written by the agent (no schema_draft.json or new schema.json)

evals.name: ask-built-graph
evals.prompt: In my mxene-no3rr knowledge graph, which catalysts reach the highest Faradaic efficiency for nitrate-to-ammonia? Cite the papers.
evals.expected_output: Ask mode: kg_search index/query with expanded terms, answer written as a standalone scientific brief with author-year citations and an APA reference list, HTML twin in answers/.
expectations: kg_search.py query output saved under answers/
Answer cites papers author-year and ends with a References list
Answer never mentions the graph, nodes, edges or retrieval
An HTML twin of the answer exists in answers/
